## Summary

In this post I walk through how I built my personal portfolio website using **RStudio + Quarto**. The entire process was done through vibe coding — iterating quickly, testing ideas in real time, and leveraging AI tools to speed up development.

### What I Covered

- Setting up a Quarto website project in RStudio
- Creating a dark theme with custom SCSS variables
- Building responsive card layouts for experience and achievements
- Adding scroll animations with vanilla JavaScript
- Deploying to GitHub Pages

### Key Takeaways

Vibe coding isn't about writing perfect code on the first try — it's about rapid iteration and learning by building. This portfolio went through several design passes before landing on the current dark minimal aesthetic.

Stay tuned for more posts on AI workflow automation and data visualization techniques.
